Name: I Don't Smoke On This Backyard - PIF
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoSunset.gif[/img]
the backyard from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47952]farmhouse[/url] mod now as a standalone PIF room (⁠｡⁠･⁠ω⁠･⁠｡⁠)⁠ﾉ⁠♡

[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoOrchestra.gif[/img]
Features:
- acts as part of the farm 
- can put buildings bcuz in fact i don't even smoke at all
- fences can be toggleable if you want to put your own design of fences
- you can plant here
- you can pass out here without penalties
- fireflies appear at night if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url] installed

[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoBattledoreBadminton.gif[/img]
Requirements:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url] (optional)

[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoJumpingRope.gif[/img]
